summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Americas Gold & Silver Corporation providing notice of its first quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call scheduled for May 15, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate action. It is a routine earnings announcement and meeting notice, which does not qualify as a special situation. The content is purely informational regarding scheduled financial results and investor communications.
